people.line: Gate in Jerusalem, associated with the tribe of Benjamin.

people.name: Chaldea
people.line: Ancient Mesopotamian empire; known for astrology and wisdom

people.name: Hananiah
people.line: A gatekeeper during the time of Jeremiah.

people.name: Irijah
people.line: Captain who arrested Jeremiah for desertion.

people.name: Jeremiah
people.line: Son of Hilkiah, the prophet during Judah's final days.

people.name: Shelemiah
people.line: Father of Irijah, who arrested Jeremiah

translations.web: When he was in Benjamin’s gate, a captain of the guard was there, whose name was Irijah, the son of Shelemiah, the son of Hananiah; and he seized Jeremiah the prophet, saying, “You are defecting to the Chaldeans!”
translations.bsb: But when he reached the Gate of Benjamin, the captain of the guard, whose name was Irijah son of Shelemiah, the son of Hananiah, seized him and said, “You are deserting to the Chaldeans!”
translations.kjv: And when he was in the gate of Benjamin, a captain of the ward was there, whose name was Irijah, the son of Shelemiah, the son of Hananiah; and he took Jeremiah the prophet, saying, Thou fallest away to the Chaldeans.
translations.asv: And when he was in the gate of Benjamin, a captain of the ward was there, whose name was Irijah, the son of Shelemiah, the son of Hananiah; and he laid hold on Jeremiah the prophet, saying, Thou art falling away to the Chaldeans.
